output.reason: The brief explains every story we've been told: the trial ran only on Press 7, D5 is wet and its alarm limit was loosened, and second shift runs mostly on Press 5. The same-lot portable-dryer test (0.8% vs 10.4% through D5) is close to decisive, and it ends with concrete actions for this week while being honest that we don't yet know why Arnholt resin arrives wetter.
